Convert design rules into Neo4j Cypher MERGE + SET statements. Output Cypher only, no JSON, no markdown fences.

CONTEXT (deterministically assembled by /context/assemble -- schema layers, SWRL conventions, and the matched Cypher catalog shape(s) with worked examples):

Example: 'maximum height 75' -> body uses swrlb:greaterThan(?val, 75), NOT swrlb:lessThanOrEqual(?val, 75)."}, "atom_ordering": {"relationship_types": ["HAS_BODY", "HAS_HEAD"], "property": "order", "statement": "Rule->Atom edges via HAS_BODY/HAS_HEAD carry an integer `order` property establishing body/head atom sequence. `order` is a reserved Cypher word and MUST be backtick-quoted: MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1)."}, "argument_rules": {"relationship_type": "ARG", "property": "pos", "statement": "Atom->Var/Literal edges via ARG carry an integer `pos` property establishing argument position. `pos` is a reserved Cypher word and MUST be backtick-quoted: MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity).", "var_merge_keys": ["name", "project"], "var_merge_statement": "Var nodes MERGE on both `name` (?<varName>) and `project` -- omitting `project` from the merge key reintroduces the v2.0 cross-project variable-collision bug (fixed per STATE.md v3.0 Phase 7 decision: 'Var merge key includes project').", "literal_merge_keys": ["lex", "datatype"], "literal_merge_statement": "Literal nodes MERGE on `lex` and `datatype`.", "builtin_merge_key": "iri", "builtin_merge_statement": "Builtin nodes MERGE on `iri` (swrlb:<builtinName>)."}, "naming_quirks": {"Rule_Id": "Rule node key property is `Rule_Id`, not `id`.", "Atom_Id": "Atom node key property is `Atom_Id` (format {Rule_Id}_A{n} for body, {Rule_Id}_H{n} for head), not `id`.", "SWRL_label": "DatatypeProperty display property is `SWRL_label`, not `label` (Class/ObjectProperty use plain `label`).", "SWRL": "Rule's SWRL-expression body property is named `SWRL`, not `text`.", "reserved_relationship_properties": ["order", "pos"]}}, "selected_cypher_shapes": [{"id": "min_limit", "name": "Minimum Limit", "description": "Constraint of the form "minimum X is N" / "at least N" / "no less than N". Mirror of max_limit: body atoms fire when the measured value falls BELOW the limit (violation-inverted) using a swrlb:lessThan Builtin atom against a Literal threshold. Rule_Id format: R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V.", "swrl_pattern": "<CLASS_NAME>(?e) ^ <PROPERTY_NAME>(?e, ?val) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?val, "<LIMIT>"^^xsd:decimal) -> <VIOLATION_PROPERTY>(?e, true)", "cypher_template": "// 1. OntoGraph -- ontology terms
MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>'})
SET C_Main.label = '<CLASS_NAME>', C_Main.project = '<PROJECT>', C_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:integer', DP_Main.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan', B_Lt.project = '<PROJECT>', B_Lt.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>'})
SET DP_V.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', DP_V.range = 'xsd:boolean', DP_V.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_V.graph = 'OntoGraph'

// 2. Metagraph -- rule node
MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V'})
SET r.SWRL = '<SWRL_EXPRESSION>', r.kind = 'violation', r.project = '<PROJECT>', r.graph = 'Metagraph'

// 3. Metagraph -- variables, literals
MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?<ENTITY_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vEntity.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vValue:Var {name: '?<VALUE_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vValue.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litX:Literal {lex: '<LIMIT>', datatype: 'xsd:integer'})
SET litX.project = '<PROJECT>', litX.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litT:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litT.project = '<PROJECT>', litT.graph = 'Metagraph'

// 4. Metagraph -- atom nodes
MERGE (a1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_A1'})
SET a1.type = 'ClassAtom', a1.iri = 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', a1.SWRL_label = '<CLASS_NAME>', a1.project = '<PROJECT>', a1.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a2:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_A2'})
SET a2.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2.iri = 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2.project = '<PROJECT>', a2.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a3:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_A3'})
SET a3.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a3.SWRL_label = 'lessThan', a3.project = '<PROJECT>', a3.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (h1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<LIMIT>_V_H1'})
SET h1.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1.iri = 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', h1.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY>', h1.project = '<PROJECT>', h1.graph = 'Metagraph'

// 5. Relationships -- rule <-> atoms
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1)

// 6. Relationships -- atoms -> ontology terms
MERGE (a1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
MERGE (h1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_V)

// 7. Relationships -- atoms -> arguments
MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litX)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litT);", "worked_example": "-- "Minimum number of parking spaces is 2" -> R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V, project 'demo-project'

MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:Building'})
SET C_Main.label = 'Building', C_Main.project = 'demo-project', C_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:parkingSpaces'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = 'parkingSpaces', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:integer', DP_Main.project = 'demo-project', DP_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan'})

MERGE (DP_V:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:parkingBelowMin'})

MERGE (r:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V'})
SET r.SWRL = 'Building(?b) ^ parkingSpaces(?b, ?p) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?p, "2"^^xsd:integer) -> parkingBelowMin(?b, true)', r.kind = 'violation', r.project = 'demo-project', r.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vEntity:Var {name: '?b', project: 'demo-project'})
SET vEntity.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vValue:Var {name: '?p', project: 'demo-project'})
SET vValue.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litX:Literal {lex: '2', datatype: 'xsd:integer'})
SET litX.project = 'demo-project', litX.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (litT:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litT.project = 'demo-project', litT.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_A1'})
SET a1.type = 'ClassAtom', a1.iri = 'ex:Building', a1.SWRL_label = 'Building', a1.project = 'demo-project', a1.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a2:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_A2'})
SET a2.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2.iri = 'ex:parkingSpaces', a2.SWRL_label = 'parkingSpaces', a2.project = 'demo-project', a2.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a3:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_A3'})
SET a3.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a3.SWRL_label = 'lessThan', a3.project = 'demo-project', a3.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (h1:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_PARKING_MIN_2_V_H1'})
SET h1.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1.iri = 'ex:parkingBelowMin', h1.SWRL_label = 'parkingBelowMin', h1.project = 'demo-project', h1.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3)
MERGE (r)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1)

MERGE (a1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
MERGE (h1)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_V)

MERGE (a1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)
MERGE (a2)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValue)
MERGE (a3)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litX)
MERGE (h1)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntity)

PRESERVES the existing cypher_template.txt convention: emit TWO SEPARATE violation Rules -- one min-rule (reusing the min_limit shape's swrlb:lessThan pattern) and one max-rule (reusing the max_limit shape's swrlb:greaterThan pattern) -- never a single combined Rule. MAX rule: <CLASS_NAME>(?e) ^ <PROPERTY_NAME>(?e, ?val) ^ swrlb:greaterThan(?val, "<MAX>"^^xsd:decimal) -> <VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MAX>(?e, true)", "cypher_template": "// Shared OntoGraph terms (MERGE-reused by both rules, same iri)
MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>'})
SET C_Main.label = '<CLASS_NAME>', C_Main.project = '<PROJECT>', C_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:decimal', DP_Main.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

// -- RULE 1 of 2: MIN violation rule (own violation property + atoms) --
MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan', B_Lt.project = '<PROJECT>', B_Lt.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (DP_VMin:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MIN>'})
SET DP_VMin.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MIN>', DP_VMin.range = 'xsd:boolean', DP_VMin.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_VMin.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (rMin:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<MIN>_V'})
SET rMin.SWRL = '<SWRL_MIN_EXPRESSION>', rMin.kind = 'violation', rMin.project = '<PROJECT>', rMin.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vEntityMin:Var {name: '?<ENTITY_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vEntityMin.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (vValueMin:Var {name: '?<VALUE_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vValueMin.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (litMin:Literal {lex: '<MIN>', datatype: 'xsd:decimal'})
SET litMin.project = '<PROJECT>', litMin.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (litTMin:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litTMin.project = '<PROJECT>', litTMin.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a1Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<MIN>_V_A1'})
SET a1Min.type = 'ClassAtom', a1Min.iri = 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', a1Min.SWRL_label = '<CLASS_NAME>', a1Min.project = '<PROJECT>', a1Min.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (a2Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<MIN>_V_A2'})

MERGE (a3Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<MIN>_V_A3'})
SET a3Min.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3Min.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a3Min.SWRL_label = 'lessThan', a3Min.project = '<PROJECT>', a3Min.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (h1Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MIN_<MIN>_V_H1'})
SET h1Min.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1Min.iri = 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MIN>', h1Min.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MIN>', h1Min.project = '<PROJECT>', h1Min.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1Min)
MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2Min)
MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3Min)
MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1Min)
MERGE (a1Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
MERGE (h1Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_VMin)

MERGE (a2Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMin)
MERGE (a2Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValueMin)
MERGE (a3Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValueMin)
MERGE (a3Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litMin)
MERGE (h1Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMin)
MERGE (h1Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litTMin);

MERGE (B_Gt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:greaterThan'})
SET B_Gt.label = 'greaterThan', B_Gt.project = '<PROJECT>', B_Gt.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (DP_VMax:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MAX>'})
SET DP_VMax.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MAX>', DP_VMax.range = 'xsd:boolean', DP_VMax.project = '<PROJECT>', DP_VMax.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (rMax:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<MAX>_V'})
SET rMax.SWRL = '<SWRL_MAX_EXPRESSION>', rMax.kind = 'violation', rMax.project = '<PROJECT>', rMax.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vEntityMax:Var {name: '?<ENTITY_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vEntityMax.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (vValueMax:Var {name: '?<VALUE_VAR>', project: '<PROJECT>'})
SET vValueMax.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (litMax:Literal {lex: '<MAX>', datatype: 'xsd:decimal'})
SET litMax.project = '<PROJECT>', litMax.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (litTMax:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litTMax.project = '<PROJECT>', litTMax.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a1Max:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<MAX>_V_A1'})
SET a1Max.type = 'ClassAtom', a1Max.iri = 'ex:<CLASS_NAME>', a1Max.SWRL_label = '<CLASS_NAME>', a1Max.project = '<PROJECT>', a1Max.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (a2Max:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<MAX>_V_A2'})
SET a2Max.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2Max.iri = 'ex:<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2Max.SWRL_label = '<PROPERTY_NAME>', a2Max.project = '<PROJECT>', a2Max.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (a3Max:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<MAX>_V_A3'})
SET a3Max.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3Max.iri = 'swrlb:greaterThan', a3Max.SWRL_label = 'greaterThan', a3Max.project = '<PROJECT>', a3Max.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (h1Max:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_<DOMAIN>_<PROPERTY>_MAX_<MAX>_V_H1'})
SET h1Max.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1Max.iri = 'ex:<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MAX>', h1Max.SWRL_label = '<VIOLATION_PROPERTY_MAX>', h1Max.project = '<PROJECT>', h1Max.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (rMax)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1Max)
MERGE (rMax)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2Max)
MERGE (rMax)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3Max)
MERGE (rMax)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1Max)
MERGE (a1Max)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2Max)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3Max)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Gt)
MERGE (h1Max)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_VMax)
MERGE (a1Max)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMax)
MERGE (a2Max)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMax)
MERGE (a2Max)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValueMax)
MERGE (a3Max)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValueMax)
MERGE (a3Max)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litMax)

Both reuse the SAME ex:Building Class and ex:height DatatypeProperty (MERGE-matched, same iri); each rule gets its own violation DatatypeProperty, Vars, and Atom subgraph.

// Shared OntoGraph terms
MERGE (C_Main:Class {iri: 'ex:Building'})
SET C_Main.label = 'Building', C_Main.project = 'demo-project', C_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (DP_Main:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:height'})
SET DP_Main.SWRL_label = 'height', DP_Main.range = 'xsd:decimal', DP_Main.project = 'demo-project', DP_Main.graph = 'OntoGraph'

// RULE 1: min-rule R_URB_HEIGHT_MIN_10_V
MERGE (B_Lt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:lessThan'})
SET B_Lt.label = 'lessThan', B_Lt.project = 'demo-project', B_Lt.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (DP_VMin:DatatypeProperty {iri: 'ex:heightBelowMin'})
SET DP_VMin.SWRL_label = 'heightBelowMin', DP_VMin.range = 'xsd:boolean', DP_VMin.project = 'demo-project', DP_VMin.graph = 'OntoGraph'

MERGE (rMin:Rule {Rule_Id: 'R_URB_HEIGHT_MIN_10_V'})
SET rMin.SWRL = 'Building(?b) ^ height(?b, ?h) ^ swrlb:lessThan(?h, "10"^^xsd:decimal) -> heightBelowMin(?b, true)', rMin.kind = 'violation', rMin.project = 'demo-project', rMin.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (vEntityMin:Var {name: '?b', project: 'demo-project'})
SET vEntityMin.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (vValueMin:Var {name: '?h', project: 'demo-project'})
SET vValueMin.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (litMin:Literal {lex: '10', datatype: 'xsd:decimal'})
SET litMin.project = 'demo-project', litMin.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (litTMin:Literal {lex: 'true', datatype: 'xsd:boolean'})
SET litTMin.project = 'demo-project', litTMin.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (a1Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_HEIGHT_MIN_10_V_A1'})
SET a1Min.type = 'ClassAtom', a1Min.iri = 'ex:Building', a1Min.SWRL_label = 'Building', a1Min.project = 'demo-project', a1Min.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (a2Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_HEIGHT_MIN_10_V_A2'})
SET a2Min.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', a2Min.iri = 'ex:height', a2Min.SWRL_label = 'height', a2Min.project = 'demo-project', a2Min.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (a3Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_HEIGHT_MIN_10_V_A3'})
SET a3Min.type = 'BuiltinAtom', a3Min.iri = 'swrlb:lessThan', a3Min.SWRL_label = 'lessThan', a3Min.project = 'demo-project', a3Min.graph = 'Metagraph'
MERGE (h1Min:Atom {Atom_Id: 'R_URB_HEIGHT_MIN_10_V_H1'})
SET h1Min.type = 'DataPropertyAtom', h1Min.iri = 'ex:heightBelowMin', h1Min.SWRL_label = 'heightBelowMin', h1Min.project = 'demo-project', h1Min.graph = 'Metagraph'

MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 1}]->(a1Min)
MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 2}]->(a2Min)
MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_BODY {`order`: 3}]->(a3Min)
MERGE (rMin)-[:HAS_HEAD {`order`: 1}]->(h1Min)
MERGE (a1Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(C_Main)
MERGE (a2Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_Main)
MERGE (a3Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(B_Lt)
MERGE (h1Min)-[:REFERS_TO]->(DP_VMin)
MERGE (a1Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMin)
MERGE (a2Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMin)
MERGE (a2Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(vValueMin)
MERGE (a3Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vValueMin)
MERGE (a3Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litMin)
MERGE (h1Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 1}]->(vEntityMin)
MERGE (h1Min)-[:ARG {`pos`: 2}]->(litTMin);

// RULE 2: max-rule R_URB_HEIGHT_MAX_75_V
MERGE (B_Gt:Builtin {iri: 'swrlb:greaterThan'})
SET B_Gt.label = 'greaterThan', B_Gt.project = 'demo-project', B_Gt.graph = 'Metagraph'
